title: WASM Infrastructure

tasks.description: Configure AssemblyScript - set up asc compiler, asconfig.json, build scripts for WASM compilation
Memory management module - implement shared memory allocation, buffer management for WASM ↔ JS data transfer
WASM loader and bridge - create JavaScript module to load WASM, manage memory, provide typed interfaces
Feature detection - detect WASM support, SIMD availability, SharedArrayBuffer for runtime capability checks
WASMBackend class skeleton - create WASMBackend implementing MatrixBackend interface with lazy loading
Fallback mechanism - implement graceful fallback to JSBackend when WASM unavailable or fails
WASM loading tests - test WASM module loading, feature detection, fallback behavior

successCriteria: WASM module loads in browser and Node.js
Feature detection correctly identifies SIMD support
Graceful fallback works when WASM unavailable
Memory management handles large matrices without leaks
notes: Sprint 5 establishes the WASM infrastructure. The WASMBackend class implements the MatrixBackend interface with automatic fallback to JSBackend for small matrices or when WASM is unavailable. Feature detection identifies WASM capabilities including SIMD, bulk memory, reference types, exceptions, and tail call support. All 337 tests passing (320 original + 17 new WASM tests).
